title: Special Topics in Information Studies; Program Assessment and Evaluation
description: Students will gain an introduction to program assessment and evaluation for public, non-profit, and private-sector information organizations. This course emphasizes the direct application of analytical skills and tools specifically appropriate to information organizations and includes focused practice in applying process evaluation and quasi-experimental methodologies. Attention is given to critical theories of evaluation and to cultural competence skills required to conduct assessment and evaluation activities while attending to various dimensions of diversity.
